mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 3pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month and payroll employment (PAYEMS) also declines, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a Goldilocks economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
